source: PSY 14 Nov (2) check: 50 ordinary kind answers through the Ask me filter; post the share dropped (more than about 1 in 5 dropped = not to friends as is). Engine's own sentences, written before any measurement; fictional; ordinary range on purpose, including care during illness, parties, appearance-adjacent kindness and keeping a confidence, because PSY names those as the answers a word filter loses.
answers: You stayed late to help me pack when I moved.
You brought soup over when I was sick with the flu.
You drove me to the hospital when my dad had his operation.
You remembered my birthday when everyone else forgot.
You listened for an hour when I called you upset.
You made sure the new people at the party had someone to talk to.
You offered to watch the kids so I could go to my appointment.
You told me my haircut looked great on a day I felt awful.
You lent me your coat when it started raining on the walk home.
You sent me a message after my interview to ask how it went.
You helped me carry the boxes up three flights of stairs.
You came to visit every week while I was in hospital.
You cooked dinner for everyone after the funeral.
You kept quiet about my news until I was ready to share it.
You stood up for me in the meeting when my idea was dismissed.
You asked how my mum was doing after her cancer treatment.
You gave up your seat for the older woman on the bus.
You showed me how to use the new software without making me feel slow.
You laughed at my terrible jokes at dinner and made me feel welcome.
You picked up my medication when I couldn't leave the house.
You sat with me in the waiting room so I wasn't alone.
You wrote me a card when my cat died.
You noticed I was quiet and asked if I was okay.
You shared your lunch with me on my first day.
You helped my son with his maths homework every Thursday.
You fixed my bike and wouldn't take any money for it.
You called me when you heard about the storm near my town.
You waited outside the exam hall to walk me home.
You organised the collection for the leaving present.
You let me cry on your shoulder after the breakup and didn't say a word.
You came to my art show even though you'd worked all day.
You cleaned up the whole kitchen after the party without being asked.
You prayed with my grandmother when she asked you to.
You walked the dog for me every morning while my ankle healed.
You helped me practise my speech the night before the wedding.
You remembered that I don't eat meat and cooked something special.
You introduced me to your friends when I'd just moved to the city.
You checked on me every day when I was ill in bed.
You defended my sister when someone made fun of her accent.
You told me the truth about my essay, kindly, and it helped.
You gave me your umbrella and got soaked yourself.
You stayed on the phone with me while I waited for the taxi.
You taught me to swim when I was scared of the water.
You helped my dad set up his phone so he could video call us.
You saved me a seat at the concert.
You covered my shift so I could go to my daughter's play.
You held the door and waited for me even though you were late.
You thanked the cleaner by name at the end of the event.
You made a playlist for my long drive.
You came with me to the clinic when I was nervous about the results.
